description: With Minos dead and Ariadne ruling Atlantis, Pasiphae returns at the head of an army and the struggle for the city becomes open war. Jason's bond with Ariadne deepens while the truth about his parentage draws him toward Pasiphae and Medea, forcing Hercules and Pythagoras to keep him from being consumed by the darker inheritance shaping his fate.

s02e01.description: Pasiphae attacks Thera and moves against Atlantis, while a betrayal inside the city allows Medea to steal the Palladium and leaves Jason, Hercules and Pythagoras racing to recover it.

s02e02.description: With Atlantis close to defeat, Jason and his friends struggle to return with the Palladium as Sarpedon tries to atone for his betrayal and Hercules discovers the truth about Jason's birth.

s02e03.description: Prince Telemon arrives for the Coronation Games and courts Ariadne, but his polished public identity conceals motives that put Jason and the newly crowned queen in danger.

s02e04.description: Ariadne travels toward Aegina with Telemon and her companions, only for betrayal and Pasiphae's forces to turn the royal journey into a desperate flight for survival.

s02e05.description: Pasiphae raises the dead inside the necropolis while Jason and Medea are forced to cooperate, ending in a betrayal that leaves Ariadne gravely wounded.

s02e06.description: Jason, Hercules and Pythagoras seek Medea's blood to break the curse on Ariadne, sending Jason into Pasiphae's territory and bringing the struggle between mother and son dangerously close.

s02e07.description: Pasiphae moves to prevent Jason and Ariadne's marriage by targeting the Oracle and exploiting Medusa, leaving Jason accused of a crime designed to destroy his standing in Atlantis.

s02e08.description: Jason, Hercules and Ariadne are imprisoned as Pasiphae's allies tighten their control of the city, while Hercules tries to persuade Medusa to reveal the truth that could save Jason.

s02e09.description: As Ariadne is pressured to surrender the throne, Pythagoras and his allies seek a way back into Atlantis and Jason confronts Pasiphae with Medusa's power, only to learn the truth of their relationship.

s02e10.description: The revelation of Pasiphae's identity darkens Jason's behavior and strains his friendships, while Pythagoras searches for Jason's father and Medea makes an unexpected choice.

s02e11.description: Jason is forced to fight in the arena, where Aeson finally reveals himself as his father and helps him escape, giving Jason the connection he needs at a devastating personal cost.

s02e12.description: Jason frees prisoners to help retake Atlantis, but betrayal turns the uprising into an ambush as he and Ariadne commit themselves to one another and prepare for the final confrontation with Pasiphae.

s02e13.description: Jason follows Medea's guidance against Pasiphae and returns to Atlantis with Ariadne, only for sorcery to overturn their victory and leave the city facing a renewed struggle for its future.
